name: abs-visitor-arrivals-direction
description: The OAD release for reference month M has just been published. For a country of residence, will short-term visitor arrivals to Australia in the first month not yet published (M+1) fall short of the same calendar month one year earlier?
license: ABS website material CC BY 4.0 International (source terms preserved; attribution 'Source: Australian Bureau of Statistics' required). Derived research dataset - not an ABS official product. Our derived compilation: CC0-1.0.

split.strategy: temporal by target month (OAD publication instant)

label_rule: fell_short = 1 iff visitor arrivals OBS_VALUE(T) < OBS_VALUE(T-12); exact ties are 0 and counted flat. Both label source columns are excluded from every shipped file.
prediction_time: The publication instant of the ABS Overseas Arrivals and Departures (OAD) release for reference month M, observed at a maximum of 43 days after month end (Aug 2026 released 2026-10-13, Jul 2026 released 2026-09-11, Apr 2026 released 2026-06-12; all 11:30am local). At that instant every month <= M is published and month M+1 - the target month - is the first unpublished month. Features are published series values for months <= M only; the target month's value and its year-earlier level never ship.
